risk_summary: The company reports substantial liquidity and going-concern risk, with $10.9 million of cash, $15.3 million of annual operating cash burn, minimal revenue, and reliance on additional financing. Failure to raise capital could delay clinical and regulatory milestones or force discontinuation of operations. Disclosure is relatively quantified but includes extensive forward-looking contingencies and standard risk language.
